current.name: Clean a Bloxbuster!
current.description:
👍 THUMBS UP FOR MORE UPDATES! 👍
Welcome to Clean the Bloxbuster! 📼

The store is a total mess! Pick up scattered tapes, sort them into the right movie categories, and fill every row and shelf to bring Bloxbuster back to life.

🎮 How to Play

📼 Sort & Restock — Pick up misplaced tapes and place them in the correct category.
🗂️ Fill the Shelves — Complete rows, restore full shelves, and make every aisle look perfect.
⬆️ Upgrade — Earn points as you clean to unlock helpful upgrades.
👥 Play Together — Clean solo or team up with friends to finish the store faster.
🏆 Compete — Beat the timer and climb the global leaderboards.

Can you clean the entire Bloxbuster and restore it to completion?
